summary: Iteration 4 — narrow-scope bug-fix pass. All 3 fixes verified: (1) mobile ElevenLabs widget + sticky CTA coexistence, (2) tax breakdown on booking page & backend /api/quote, (3) itemized customer + admin confirmation emails via shared _breakdown_rows helper. Full booking regression still lands on /booking/confirmation/:id.
critical_code_review_comments: emailer.py:9 uses os.environ[...] at import-time. In test contexts where EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is unset, this will crash import. Tests handle it via setdefault before importing, but a load-time getenv with a default (or lazy access inside send_email) would be more resilient.

Booking.jsx keeps a computed frontend quote in the client but the backend recomputes on POST — good practice (client cannot manipulate price). Values matched exactly in this test, but ensure any future frontend-only tweak (e.g., rounding tie-break) is mirrored in pricing.py to avoid drift.

StickyMobileCTA uses z-40 and index.css raises elevenlabs-convai to z-60 via !important. Fine for now — worth adding a brief comment in StickyMobileCTA.jsx pointing to the index.css override so future edits don't lower it.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ prefixed bookings during regression + persistence tests. Booking IDs generated on-the-fly (e.g., MG-B1617B); not cleaned up (no delete endpoint), but flagged with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_quote_and_bookings.py — reuse for regression. Mobile sticky CTA measured at (x=16, w=99) so bottom-right corner is free for Convai widget; widget zIndex computed to '60'.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified E1's fixes. Root cause of prior mobile-widget bug was a full-width sticky bar overlapping the widget mount; fix narrowed the sticky CTA to a left-anchored pill (bottom-4 left-4, auto width) and defensively raised elevenlabs-convai z-index to 60 via a global CSS rule.
